E1.yt_title: You woke up in 1294. What do you do? 🐫 Wrong Century Ep.1 #shorts
E1.yt_description:
Episode 1 — Wrong Century
You fell asleep in 2026. You woke up in a Silk Road caravanserai in Tabriz, 1294 — and a caravan master thinks you're his new guard.

🗳️ Comment A or B — Episode 2 follows the vote.
A = Play the guard · B = Run into the city

📜 History note: Tabriz was the Ilkhanate's great trading hub, where Venetian, Genoese, Armenian and Persian merchants met.
